decisions.reason: The necessary impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, which records both approved passages; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The approved meal and partner-support passages do not change the independent constraint requiring removal of the unintended newline marker from the book title.
Approval of two manuscript passages does not alter the requirement to provide paperback publishing-process guidance.
The two approved editorial passages do not change the selected paperback publication format or its layout scope.
